Chapter 591: Chapter 26 On the Brink of Collapse (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

Among the twelve Prime Gods of the Ocean of Light, the God of Divination is the most unique, and also the best-tempered.

The other Prime Gods, such as the Main God of Rank, Goddess of the Magic Web, Rainbow Dragon God, and so on, are almost absolutely rational, spending their time either in slumber or in seclusion.

Only the God of Divination would sometimes solve their doubts.

Previously, the gods had sought the God of Divination to deduce the last known locations of the vanished demigods.

Now it seems that this deduction was clearly correct, with the strength of the Longshan Patriarch, secretly abducting some demigods was too easy.

...

“Could the Longshan Patriarch be a deity who nearly perished long ago before the Divine Kingdom plunged into the mortal realm?”

A True God speculated.

In the distant past, several divine wars had occurred, with many deities perishing and Divine Kingdoms falling into the mortal realm.

However, the fall of a Divine Kingdom into the mortal realm did not mean certain death, as long as there were still believers in the mortal realm, the perished deity still had a possibility of returning.

Of course, the probability of such a possibility was so low as to be pitiable, merely a theoretical possibility, and in reality, it had never occurred.

But the Longshan Patriarch was too powerful, so some True Gods couldn’t help but think in this direction.

“Whether he is a perished deity from the past or not, once we see the God of Divination, everything will become clear,” another True God responded.

They had absolute trust in the God of Divination.

…

Longshan Great Hall.

Within the cultivation room.

Lin Yuan sat down cross-legged again.

“The taste of a divine power incarnation is somewhat better than that of mere ‘Divine Crystals’.”

Lin Yuan smacked his lips, casually giving his opinion, knowing that in the Main World Prime Universe, the pure energy contained within these divine power incarnations far exceeded that of ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid’.

“It’s a pity that it is only an incarnation, if it were the True God himself… At least I could have tried out the effects of True Divine Nature…”

Lin Yuan felt a bit of regret.

With his current strength, the incarnations of the True Gods weren’t much different from the originals, as the absolute control over nearly a hundred million Spatial Layers allowed Lin Yuan to overpower any True God or even a Prime God on the spatial level.

“But it won’t be long now.”

“Once I completely understand the last bit of spatial essence in the Demigod Lattice.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, in his eyes, the spatial essence contained in the Demigod Lattice was a reflection of the spatial essence of this world.

It was like a television; the demigods only knew to watch programs through it.

But Lin Yuan was deducing a complete modern factory industrial chain through the television itself, and from that, comprehending all of modern industry.

Of course, the spatial essence of a world was many times more difficult than a mere industrial chain, it was just an analogy.

The spatial essence corresponding to the Demigod Lattice belonged to the foundational part; Lin Yuan needed to thoroughly understand it in order to contemplate the spatial essence corresponding to True Divine Nature with more efficiency.

“Space…”

Layers upon layers of spatial levels faintly emerged in the depths of Lin Yuan’s eyes.

The layers within his Inner World were also rapidly emerging, with new spatial layers being born almost at every passing moment.

“Hmm?”

Suddenly, Lin Yuan stopped his contemplation and turned his head in a certain direction.

“Have you had enough of watching?” Lin Yuan muttered to himself.

Rustle rustle.

Invisible forces converged.

A tall and cold-eyed, breathtakingly beautiful woman appeared.

The very moment this woman appeared, the rules of heaven and earth seemed to make way, and an aura superior to that of True Gods spread and permeated the surrounding.

“Goddess of the Magic Web?”

Lin Yuan looked at the beautiful woman not far away, without any sign of surprise.

Who knew first about Lin Yuan’s actions against the numerous divine incarnations?

Their True God selves in the Ocean of Light, or the Rank Pope beside Lin Yuan?

Neither.

The first to detect the anomaly was this Goddess of the Magic Web, who covered the entire mortal realm with her web and was one of the twelve Prime Gods of the Ocean of Light.

Where the Magic Web extended, that was the expanse of the Goddess’s perceptual range.

When Lin Yuan moved against the Lust Church, and the Primordial Spirit personally descended upon the Lust Church’s stronghold, it was out of wariness of this Goddess of the Magic Web, fearing that unleashing too powerful a force would attract her attention.

“Longshan Patriarch, who exactly are you…” the Goddess of the Magic Web’s eyes shone with a peculiar light as she looked at Lin Yuan and slowly inquired.

As a Prime God, exalted above all, overlooking all living beings and gods, little in this world could stir their emotions anymore.

But Lin Yuan was certainly one who could.

“Who I am, you’ll know soon enough.”

“I will personally enter the Ocean of Light. By then, I hope you Prime Gods will not disappoint me.”

Lin Yuan couldn’t be bothered to commune with these Prime Gods, raising his right hand as the terrifying force of the world, combined with the power of multiple spatial layers, swept away everything.

The Goddess of the Magic Web before him was merely an incarnation formed by the Magic Web that enshrouded the mortal world, naturally, she couldn’t withstand a casual blow from Lin Yuan.

“`

“Magic Web?”

Lin Yuan looked around, his thoughts stirring slightly.

His power spread in all directions, driving away the ever-present Magic Web. Without the Magic Web, how would members of the Longshan Family communicate?

With Lin Yuan’s strength, it was entirely possible to reconstruct a new ‘communication network’ to replace the original Magic Web.

…

Ocean of Light.

True Gods gathered in front of the towering temple of the God of Divination.

The events they had recently experienced had already spread among the gods: the emergence of a powerful stranger in the human realm, comparable to the Prime God, was too significant not to proliferate.

Thus, the True Gods converging in front of the temple numbered in the hundreds; at least eighty percent of the Divine Lattice-holders of the entire Ocean of Light had been attracted here.

Even from afar, the will of the Prime Gods lingered, watching.

At that moment, the temple doors opened.

The white-robed God of Divination emerged.

“I already know why you have come,” said the God of Divination, a white-haired elder with a gentle tone and a warm gaze.

“To clarify the origins of the Longshan Patriarch is no difficult task,” he said calmly, though he too was curious.

He had initially foretold the vanishing Demigods’ last traces at Longshan Ling but hadn’t continued to divine further.

He hadn’t expected the situation to cause such an uproar.

“Thank you, God of Divination.”

“The God of Divination knows all. The origins of the Longshan Patriarch will undoubtedly be revealed to us soon,” the True Gods said with livened spirits. The combat power the Longshan Patriarch had demonstrated, no weaker than the Prime Gods, intrigued them greatly.

“Then I shall begin.”

The God of Divination smiled slightly, silently reciting the Longshan Patriarch’s name and the specific location of Longshan Ling.

He then activated the power of Time Main God Form within him, leveraging the rules and Great Dao of this world to probe the true history of the Longshan Patriarch.

Whirl, whirl.

Scenes manifested in front of the God of Divination.

They depicted past events that had occurred at Longshan Ling.

These events started to unfold before the God of Divination, rewinding in time.

One hundred years.

Two hundred years.

Three hundred years.

Four hundred years.

In an instant, time had traveled back four to five hundred years.

“What could the origins be…” murmured the God of Divination, his expression tinged with expectation.

Foretelling, essentially, was an act of time; by leveraging the Time Main God Form within him, he could trace back into the past.

That’s why he was known as omniscient.

After all, as long as he traced back far enough, nothing in the world remained a secret to the God of Divination.

In the Ocean of Light, among the twenty-four Prime Gods of the dark abyss, the God of Divination might not have been the strongest in combat power, but he was certainly the hardest to kill.

Watching the past had granted the God of Divination countless means to save his life.

Hum.

Time continued to reverse.

But at a certain node…

The slow reversal of time came to an impasse.

“Hmm?”

The God of Divination’s expression shifted slightly, as he had never encountered such a situation before.

Something was actually withstanding his reversal of time.

The God of Divination hurriedly examined the scene. The young Longshan Patriarch was lying on the bed when he suddenly opened his eyes.

The next moment.

The reversed flow of time, as if encountering an unimaginable entity.

The entire River of Time began to ripple, and the God of Divination’s expression drastically changed. He clearly felt a backlash from the River of Time, almost devouring him.

Spurt.

The God of Divination turned ashen, his breath plunging continuously, and cracks began to appear within his Time Main God Form.

Above the firmament.

The enormous star representing the God of Divination, which almost illuminated one-tenth of the sky, suddenly began to shake violently.

It teetered on the brink.
